tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me. I'd like to ask you some questions about career choices. First, from what you've seen, what kinds of careers do people around you tend to pursue? For example, do they work in healthcare, education, technology, or something else?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你抽出时间与我交流。我想问你一些关于职业选择的问题。首先，在你看来，你身边的人大多倾向于从事哪些职业？比如，他们是在医疗、教育、科技行业工作，还是其他领域？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. When choosing a career, is job satisfaction your first priority, or do you focus more on salary? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：明白了。选择职业时，你会把工作满意度放在首位，还是更看重薪资待遇？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Next, I'd like to get your opinion. In recent years, there has been atrend towards people changing careers multiple times throughout their lives instead of sticking to one profession. What are your thoughts on this trend? Do you think it's helpful or hurtful to workers?
tasks.analysis: 中文：挺有意思的。接下来我想听听你的看法。近年来，出现了一种趋势：人们一生中会多次更换职业，而不是固守一份工作。你如何看待这种趋势？你认为这对职场人士是有益还是有害？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. I just have one more question. Some people believe that artificial intelligence will greatly change the kinds of jobs available in the future. Do you think this trend will continue in your chosen field? Why or why not?
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得很有道理。我还有最后一个问题。有些人认为，人工智能将极大地改变未来可从事的工作类型。你认为这一趋势在你选择的领域中还会持续下去吗？为什么会或为什么不会？
tasks.title: Interview
